name: guest_checkout_allowed
label: Allow guest checkout
help_text: When enabled, users without a member account can register by providing their name and email.

name: membership_offer_message
label: Membership offer message
default: Become a Weld Australia member and save on future registrations.

name: payment_provider
label: Payment provider
help_text: event_engine reserves a seat in the Event Engine worker and redirects to the HubSpot-hosted invoice (requires the worker base URL below + per-session worker_event_id and ticket type ids in the courses HubDB). hapily and redirect both send the user to registration_url in HubDB. Stripe processes payment inline (requires backend PaymentIntent endpoint).

name: worker_base_url
label: Event Engine worker base URL
help_text: Leave blank to inherit the theme-wide setting at Design Manager → Theme settings → Integrations → Event Engine worker base URL, which selects the Worker. Keep that on `Production`, which is event-engine.refuel-creative.workers.dev. The Worker formerly deployed as event-engine-staging was RENAMED to it and that hostname no longer resolves, so do not put it back. Only set a value here to override that for this one module.

name: worker_portal_id
label: Worker portal id override
help_text: Sent to the worker as X-Portal-Id. Defaults to this HubSpot account's Hub ID. Set only if the worker keys tenants on a different id.

name: turnstile_site_key
label: Cloudflare Turnstile site key
help_text: Public site key only. Used to show Turnstile for free public Event Engine checkout. Keep the secret key in Cloudflare Worker secrets, never in HubSpot.

name: stripe_publishable_key
label: Stripe publishable key
help_text: pk_live_... or pk_test_... - publishable key only, never the secret key.

name: section_id
label: Section anchor ID (optional)
help_text: Used for in-page anchor links. Lower-case, hyphenated. Leave blank if not needed.

name: members_only
label: Members only
help_text: When true, this section is only rendered for logged-in active members.
